name: tooljet-app-builder
description: Build data-connected dashboards, internal tools and back-office apps in ToolJet, then refine them visually. Requires a ToolJet connection.

deployment_url.title: ToolJet deployment URL
deployment_url.description: The URL where you open your ToolJet instance. Your token is sent only to the API URL configured below, or this URL when the API URL is blank.

api_url.title: ToolJet API URL (optional)
api_url.description: Leave blank when your API and frontend share the deployment URL. Set this only for a deployment with a separate API origin.

personal_access_token.title: ToolJet personal access token
personal_access_token.description: Create a token in Settings → Access tokens in your intended workspace. The plugin acts with that token's permissions. Enter it here, never in chat.
